segments.text: Welcome back to my series where I show you cooking Indian food is actually easy today. I'm making creamy chicken kofta
This one will blow your mind
You got to try this one
I start by mixing ground chicken onions ginger garlic cilantro mint lemon juice
Gee and a few spices in a bowl as always a full recipe will be posted on my website for free or down below
Then I form it into balls and set it aside next heat up your oils of 350 Fahrenheit and fry them up for five minutes
Or golden brown now. Let's make the curry to pan at oil some whole spices chopped onions ginger garlic and green chilies
Let the onions cook down to a golden then go in with some spices as before and tomato puree
Bring the heat down and stir in some whisked yogurt
The secret is to let the gravy cook for 15 to 20 minutes on medium low heat add a bit of water to thin it out
Adding cream, garam masala, salt, sugar and the chicken kofta. Now it's time to enjoy
